name: wiro-ai
description: Run image, video, audio and LLM models, build workflows and manage AI agents on Wiro AI without leaving Devin
shortDescription: Run AI models, workflows and agents

setup.notice: Devin opens the Wiro sign-in page the first time it connects. Sign in, pick the project whose wallet pays for runs and agent plans, and click Allow.
steps: Sign up at wiro.ai if you don't have an account yet
When Devin opens the Wiro sign-in page, sign in, pick a project and click Allow
